seo.title: Zanskar Mountain Biking — 10 Days in Ladakh | Adventure Access
seo.description: Ten days of shuttle-supported freeride and technical riding in Zanskar, on trails built by herders, not bike parks. From $4,989, double occupancy.

hero.title: Zanskar

intro.label: The Journey
intro.heading: Not a Bike Park
paragraphs: Riding in Zanskar is starting to make headlines, but it has mostly been reserved for sponsored riders with big budgets. Finding more than a 300-meter line with a good backdrop takes insider knowledge.

The trails here are raw. Locals use them to move between villages and to drive yaks and goats up and down the mountain. Above them are scree slopes no bike has touched. Our local guides know where to drop in and where to finish, so the riding is rarely interrupted. From airport pickup to drop-off, they take care of the rest.

dayTypes.label: How the Days Work
dayTypes.heading: Ride Hard, Acclimatize First
dayTypes.lede: With altitudes pushing 16,000 feet, we ease in. The first riding day is deliberately easy so your body adjusts and you can dial in your bike after the flight.

cards.title: Riding days
cards.body: Days 2–6: freeride lines off high passes, fast gravel, palace laps and rocky technical trail, with shuttles back to the top. For experienced riders only.

cards.title: Village evenings
cards.body: Homestays in Zanskar's villages, hearty Ladakhi meals and a night at Nimmu House to finish the mountains.

cards.title: Leh and Delhi
cards.body: Day 8 in Leh with a bike park, markets or a short hike, then a night in Delhi before you fly home.

chapters.label: The Journey in Chapters
chapters.heading: Ten Days in the Saddle and Out

groups.title: Leh and the Moonlands — Easing In

image.alt: Lamayuru monastery and village on the cliffs above the Moonlands

prose: The first two days are about the altitude. Take it easy in Leh, then ride above Lamayuru, where the monastery sits against a barren, otherworldly landscape known as the Moonlands.

days.label: Day 1
days.text: Fly through New Delhi to Leh. Rest, adjust to the time zone and the altitude, and get a trip briefing.

days.label: Day 2
days.text: Drop slightly lower to Khaltse, then an afternoon of relatively easy riding around Lamayuru and the Moonlands at 14,000+ feet. Time to fine-tune your bike after the flight. Don't be fooled: pick your lines and it gets aggressive fast.

groups.title: Zangla — Sirsir La and the Palace Lines

image.alt: Zangla's old palace on a rock outcrop below snow peaks

prose: Into Zanskar over its highest roads. A freeride line snakes down from Sirsir La, then two nights in Zangla, the ancient royal capital, with a short and very scenic line from the old palace into the village.

days.label: Day 3
days.text: Loop the freeride and fast gravel lines off Sirsir La a few times before lunch at the tea shop below. Over another pass to Zangla, and laps on the palace line until you've had enough.

days.label: Day 4
days.text: Tour the palace ruins, ride a big, flowing freeride line in the Padum valley, and maybe visit a monastery. A hearty Ladakhi dinner back at the homestay.

groups.title: Lingshed, Kyupa La and Nerak — Technical Days

image.alt: Green terraces and whitewashed houses in a Zanskar village

prose: One of the staff's favorite rides in the region, rocky and technical into Lingshed, then free riding off Kyupa La with shuttles back to the top.

days.label: Day 5
days.text: Drive to the pass above Lingshed and ride Hello Hill onto a rocky, technical trail that drops in above Lingshed Monastery.

days.label: Day 6
days.text: Free riding from Kyupa La down to Yulchung, then again, or try a new line. Transfer to Nerak, with one more technical descent from the top of the village to the river, and some rest.

groups.title: Nimmu House and Leh

image.alt: The gate and courtyard of Nimmu House

prose: The mountain riding is done, and Nimmu House is the way to finish it: a historic village home turned small hotel with excellent food. Then a last day in Leh, your way.

days.label: Day 7
days.text: Nimmu House: courtyards, traditional rooms, a tour with the owner and Asian fusion dinner.

days.label: Day 8
days.text: Jumps and berms at the bike park north of town, the old market and the Central Asian Museum, or a short hike to Shanti Stupa or the palace. A celebration dinner with the week's best stories.

image.alt: Auto rickshaws on a wide New Delhi avenue

days.label: Day 9
days.text: An early flight from Leh and an afternoon and evening touring New Delhi.

days.label: Day 10
days.text: Fly home, or ask us to help you add another destination on the way.

goodToKnow.label: Good to Know
goodToKnow.heading: Before You Go
goodToKnow.lede: A few things that shape how this trip runs.

cards.title: Experienced riders only
cards.body: Most trails were not built for bikes, or there is no trail at all: steep descents, scree slopes and rocky technical terrain. This trip is not for beginners.

cards.title: Altitude
cards.body: Altitudes push 16,000 feet. We ease into riding so you don't burn out on day two and lose the rest of the trip recovering.

cards.title: Your bike
cards.body: Day 2 is built in part to sort out your bike after the flight. Personal gear is not included; we send a packing list and can advise.

cards.title: Water and the land
cards.body: Instead of hundreds of plastic bottles, we provide a more sustainable way to keep you supplied with clean water. We take our cues from local partners on where and how we ride.

cards.title: Where your money goes
cards.body: We give 3% of general revenue to sponsor children in Zanskar, so they can go to school.

cards.title: Living in India?
cards.body: Reach out to info@adventure-access.com for a modified itinerary and pricing for residents.

stays.label: Where You'll Stay
stays.heading: Village Homes and One Heritage House
paragraphs: Most villages in Zanskar have no hotels, and that is part of why we go. Homestays vary, some rustic and some with more comforts. Nimmu House is the 5-star finish in the mountains. In Leh we prefer 3–4 star places with hospitable owners over glossy hotels with poor service, and in Delhi a 5-star hotel.
